## What ships

- **`ops/gcp/fleet-sweep.sh`** — the gated leg-runner. `--check` plans the full contract order offline with no ADC/network; `--apply` gates on project → window (weekday 14:00–20:00Z, else exit 42 queued) → ADC → `SIG_SWEEP_AUTHOR` (the recorded OM-20 operator id) → per-leg evidence preconditions. Legs: `prestate` (sha256-sidecarred captures) → `backup` (AR-2 on-demand backup polled to `SUCCESSFUL`; destructive legs refuse without `backup/verified.txt`; bucket-versioning clause) → `cron` (the four OR-semantics reconciles, each updated only when live shows the offending schedule, read-back verified) → `export-guard` (rolls the exit-64 baked args onto `sig-export`) → `ar-dryrun` (merged policy + recorded `sig.ar-cleanup-candidates/1`; **refuses if any candidate is live-referenced**) → `delete` (exactly the six `[[retired_jobs]]` names, describe-json+yaml first, absent read-back — never a glob) → `ar-apply` (`--no-dry-run`, post-describe asserts policies live + dryRun=false) → `alerts` (`SIG_SWEEP_ALERTS_DISPOSITION=retire|rebuild` — retire refuses if Monitoring coverage captures empty) → `proof` (poststate asserts + partial live-diff). `rollback` replays recorded cron pre-states and prints per-job recreation recipes; never window-gated.
- **`ops/cadence.toml`** — three OR-semantics rows corrected (`eyes_on_flock` → `0 5 * * 0`, `openstates` → `0 5 * * 2`, `congress_gov` → `0 5 3 * *`), `cron_or_semantics_ok` flags dropped, `[[retired_jobs]]` declares the six-name deletion contract with required reasons.
- **`ops/src/ops/scheduled.py` + `live_diff.py`** — `RetiredJob` parse + `retired_lint` (unique, reasoned, never colliding with cadence/manual/probe/live-diff jobs); a live job on the retired list reports a distinct *"declared retired but still live"* finding; unlisted live jobs stay unlisted drift.
- **`ops/src/ops/ar_cleanup.py` + `ops/gcp/ar-cleanup-policy.json` + `sig-ops ar-cleanup merged-policy|candidates`** — the offline evaluator: delete >30d; keep <30d, newest-10 per package, and the generated `keep-live-referenced` rule covering every `@sha256:` digest a live job/service/revision references.
- **`ops/src/ops/alerts.py` + `sig-ops alert-serve`** — the repo-owned `sig-alerts` receiver (bearer or `X-SIG-Alert-Token`, secrets scrubbed before the log line, 204) replacing the inline base64 program; `WebhookNotifier` gains the `SIG_ALERT_WEBHOOK_IAM=1` OIDC path (metadata-server id token at the front door + app token header) for the private rebuild.
- **`ops/gcp/export.sh`** — `sig-export`'s baked args become `SIG_EXPORT_GUARD` (exit 64); `export.sh run` overrides args at execute time, so a bare execution is a recorded no-op instead of a stale `--as-of`.
- **`ops/gcp/wave-a.sh`** — the `if ! _gate; then rc=$?` defect repaired (negation masked the code to 0; now `|| rc=$?` propagates a NO-GO's real status, matching wave-b.sh).
- **`ops/iam_identities.toml`** — comment records the post-sweep count (100 → 94) and the six `jobs`-list drops riding the sweep's apply.
